resources.string: With your consent, Restrainify reads which app is open, on-screen labels that identify feeds like Reels and Shorts, and the web address in supported browsers, to restrict the apps, feeds and sites you choose and enforce your limits. If you turn on the Visual filter, it also captures the screen to check it on your device. During a timed uninstall lock or a Burst cooldown with uninstall protection enabled, it looks for uninstall and settings screens. It can show a restriction screen and return Home. A timed uninstall lock cannot be shortened or cancelled in the app. Device Administrator access is released after every uninstall lock ends. This is not tamper-proof: administrator removal, safe mode, and system resets can bypass it. Nothing it reads is saved or uploaded. Android still lets you turn accessibility off in Settings.
